armaduras.d:
A headband that holds cloth in place.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

o.en: On a corpse in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).

armaduras.d:
A headband with the cloth removed.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

o.en: Made by altering the regular version at a Site of Grace (needs the original piece).
o.pt: Feito ao alterar a versão comum em uma Graça (precisa da peça original).

armaduras.d:
Valuable headband featuring fine goldwork.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Leather hat decorated with a withered feather.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Cowl made of soft cloth.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Hood of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Engraved golden mask.
Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Decorated with many-colored flowers.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Decorated with a stunning array of flowers.

o.en: Made by altering the regular version at a Site of Grace (needs the original piece).
o.pt: Feito ao alterar a versão comum em uma Graça (precisa da peça original).

armaduras.d:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown.

The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by the collar of sharpened branches.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau)) for 500 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau)) por 500 runas.

armaduras.d:
Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.
Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling.

A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

o.en: Sold by Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River (Siofra River)) for 1,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River (Siofra River)) por 1.000 runas.

armaduras.d:
Iron mask forced on convicted prisoners.
Worn by the blackguard Big Boggart.

To Boggart, the mask made him all the more threatening, and helped him get what he wanted. But it was also a mirror of his emptiness.

o.en: Found in Capital Outskirts - South of Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Capital Outskirts - South of Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Blackguard in Liurnia of the Lakes - Boilprawn Shack, Fallen Ruins of the Lake. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Blackguard em Liurnia of the Lakes - Boilprawn Shack, Fallen Ruins of the Lake. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood.

Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

o.en: Found in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital), near the Underground Roadside grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital), perto da graça Underground Roadside.

armaduras.d:
Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty.
It magnifies one's fears and makes them acutely aware of all forms of pain.

Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness.

When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the head.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

o.en: On a corpse in Seethewater Cave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Seethewater Cave (Altus Plateau).

armaduras.d:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece.

Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot.

Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

o.en: On a corpse in Lake of Rot (Siofra River), near the Grand Cloister grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Lake of Rot (Siofra River), perto da graça Grand Cloister.

armaduras.d:
Hood fashioned from supple cloth.
Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Laskyar Ruins, Malefactor's Evergaol) for 1,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Laskyar Ruins, Malefactor's Evergaol) por 1.000 runas.

armaduras.d:
Cap worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy.

Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

o.en: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes - Behind Caria Manor, Royal Grave Evergaol, Part of Ravine, near the Manor Upper Level grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Liurnia of the Lakes - Behind Caria Manor, Royal Grave Evergaol, Part of Ravine, perto da graça Manor Upper Level.

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence to the detriment of stamina.

The Karolos Conspectus is the oldest of the academy's lineages of study, begat by the sorcerer Azur. Scholars who follow in his footsteps pursue the mysteries of comets.

o.en: Reward for defeating Albinauric Crab in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Albinauric Crab em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP.

The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

o.en: On a corpse in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Schoolhouse Classroom grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Schoolhouse Classroom.

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina.

Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kinds.

o.en: Reward for defeating Albinauric Crab in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Albinauric Crab em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and arcane to the detriment of stamina.

This gentle-looking crown was granted to a scholar who excelled in her studies, which also merited the title of "witch."

o.en: Found in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Reward for defeating Sorceress Sellen in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Sorceress Sellen em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Sorceress Sellen in Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Sorceress Sellen em Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and dexterity to the detriment of HP.

Scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus study Carian sorceries—a heterodox pursuit that views the moon as equal to the stars.

o.en: Reward for defeating Albinauric Crab in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Albinauric Crab em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and strength to the detriment of FP.

Scholars of the Haima Conspectus sought the power to quell conflict, and to this end studied the sorceries of cannon fire and the gavel.

o.en: Dropped by Battlemage in Altus Plateau - West Windmill Pasture, near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace.
o.pt: Deixado por Battlemage em Altus Plateau - West Windmill Pasture, perto da graça Road of Iniquity Side Path.

armaduras.d:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and endurance to the detriment of FP.

The crown of Hierodas was granted to scholars who engaged in nomadic study away from the academy.

o.en: On a corpse in Mt. Gelmir - Seethewater River, Hermit Village, Wyndham Catacombs Entrance, Sage's Cave Entrance, Abductor Virgins Exit (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mt. Gelmir - Seethewater River, Hermit Village, Wyndham Catacombs Entrance, Sage's Cave Entrance, Abductor Virgins Exit (Altus Plateau).

armaduras.d:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

o.en: Found in Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), near the Table of Lost Grace grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), perto da graça Table of Lost Grace. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Mad Tongue Alberich's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner.

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthens thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Fortified Manor, First Floor grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Fortified Manor, First Floor.

armaduras.d:
Mad Tongue Alberich's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner.

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthens thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

o.en: Made by altering the regular version at a Site of Grace (needs the original piece).
o.pt: Feito ao alterar a versão comum em uma Graça (precisa da peça original).

armaduras.d:
Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim.
Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

Increases mind to the detriment of stamina.

Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

o.en: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread.
Increases arcane.

When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their matters were to be kept strictly private.

o.en: On a corpse in Divine Tower of Liurnia (Liurnia of the Lakes), near Carian Study Hall.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Divine Tower of Liurnia (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto de Carian Study Hall.

armaduras.d:
Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.

This crown replaced Azur's brain and skull altogether, and now, removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains within raises the potency of Azur's primeval current sorceries at the cost of additional FP consumption.

o.en: Dropped by Primeval Sorcerer Azur in Mt. Gelmir - Primeval Sorcerer Azur, Gelmir Hero's Grave Entrance (Altus Plateau). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Primeval Sorcerer Azur em Mt. Gelmir - Primeval Sorcerer Azur, Gelmir Hero's Grave Entrance (Altus Plateau). Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

This crown replaced Lusat's brain and skull altogether, and now, removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains within raises the potency of Lusat's primeval current sorceries at the cost of additional FP consumption.

o.en: Dropped by Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway (Caelid). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Primeval Sorcerer Lusat em Sellia Hideaway (Caelid). Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
A tall crown depicting the moon.
Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 7,000 runes after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 7.000 runas depois de derrotar Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

armaduras.d:
Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through.
Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery.
Strengthens cold sorcery.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries.
It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

o.en: Inside a chest in Liurnia of the Lakes - Renna's Rise. Can be missed.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Liurnia of the Lakes - Renna's Rise. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head.
Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk.

o.en: Found in Deeproot Depths (Siofra River), near the Prince of Death's Throne grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River), perto da graça Prince of Death's Throne. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

o.en: Sold by Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts - Northeast Outer Wall Battleground, Hermit Merchant's Shack (Altus Plateau)) for 1,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts - Northeast Outer Wall Battleground, Hermit Merchant's Shack (Altus Plateau)) por 1.000 runas.

armaduras.d:
Hood worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

o.en: On a corpse in Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance.

armaduras.d:
Fillet worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

o.en: Found in Bellum Highway - Church of Inhibition, Southwest of Grand Lift of Dectus (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Encontrado em Bellum Highway - Church of Inhibition, Southwest of Grand Lift of Dectus (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armaduras.d:
A burgundy pointed hood.
Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

o.en: On a corpse in Stillwater Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stillwater Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armaduras.d:
Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover.
A burial shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they sought.

Increases intelligence and faith to the detriment of HP.

"Yes, surely this is the moon that young Rennala gazed upon."

o.en: Found in Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance.
o.pt: Encontrado em Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance.

armaduras.d:
A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo.
Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism.

Strengthens Golden Order incantations.

Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit.

"To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

o.en: On a corpse in Altus Plateau - Road of Iniquity Side Path, near Writheblood Ruins.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Altus Plateau - Road of Iniquity Side Path, perto de Writheblood Ruins.

armaduras.d:
Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

o.en: On a corpse in Caelid - West Aeonia Swamp, near Street of Sages Ruins.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Caelid - West Aeonia Swamp, perto de Street of Sages Ruins.

armaduras.d:
Headscarf worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Mask in the image of a wizened sage.
Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation.
Increases faith.

Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality.
One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

o.en: On a corpse in Altus Plateau - Abandoned Coffin, Ruin-Strewn Precipice Exit.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Altus Plateau - Abandoned Coffin, Ruin-Strewn Precipice Exit.

armaduras.d:
Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the image of a foreign queen.
Increases dexterity.

Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort.
She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy.

In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

o.en: Found in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), near the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble.
Customarily worn by the head of House Marais.
Increases arcane.

The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

o.en: Reward for defeating Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan in Mt. Gelmir - First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Corpse-Stench Shack; Altus Plateau - West of Shaded Castle.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan em Mt. Gelmir - First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Corpse-Stench Shack; Altus Plateau - West of Shaded Castle.

armaduras.d:
Headband decorated by a pair of great horns.
Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

armaduras.d:
Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns.
Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

Horns with buds that also shine are ideal ceremonial items for ancestral worship. Strengthens Ancestral Infant's Head.

o.en: Dropped by Ancestral Follower Shaman in Nokron (Siofra River), near Hallowhorn Grounds.
o.pt: Deixado por Ancestral Follower Shaman em Nokron (Siofra River), perto de Hallowhorn Grounds.

armaduras.d:
Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

o.en: Reward for defeating Godskin Apostle in Divine Tower of Caelid (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Godskin Apostle em Divine Tower of Caelid (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow).

armaduras.d:
Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft.
Worn by Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

o.en: Reward for defeating Godskin Noble in Divine Tower of Liurnia (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Godskin Noble em Divine Tower of Liurnia (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armaduras.d:
Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery.
Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

o.en: Reward for defeating Sanguine Noble in Consecrated Snowfield - North of Yelough Anix Ruins (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Sanguine Noble em Consecrated Snowfield - North of Yelough Anix Ruins (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armaduras.d:
Red scarab worn directly on the head.
The red scarabs roll clumps of crimson tears during their labors.

Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but increases damage taken.

o.en: On a corpse in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), near the Temple of Eiglay grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Temple of Eiglay.

armaduras.d:
Blue scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Cerulean Tears, but increases damage taken.

o.en: On a corpse in Caelid - East Sellia, Church of the Plague, Sellia Hideaway Entrance, near Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Caelid - East Sellia, Church of the Plague, Sellia Hideaway Entrance, perto de Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

armaduras.d:
Gray scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of Ashes of War during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP cost of skills, but increases damage taken.

o.en: On a corpse in Divine Tower of Limgrave, near Limgrave Colosseum.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Divine Tower of Limgrave, perto de Limgrave Colosseum.

armaduras.d:
Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP costs of sorceries, but increases damage taken.

o.en: Inside a chest in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Raya Lucaria Grand Library grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Raya Lucaria Grand Library.

armaduras.d:
Golden scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken.

As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for the long journey to its home nest.

o.en: Found in Limgrave - Agheel Lake, Dragon-Burnt Ruins.
o.pt: Encontrado em Limgrave - Agheel Lake, Dragon-Burnt Ruins.

armaduras.d:

armaduras.d:
Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.
Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

o.pt: Em um cadáver em Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael, perto da graça Elphael Inner Wall.

armaduras.d:
Metal helm with a pointed beak.
Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master.
Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

o.en: Dropped by Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Deixado por Bloodhound Knight em Gelmir Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).

armaduras.d:
Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

Helm worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

Vargram's nickname comes from the white wolf's mane that decorates this helm.

A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments. Symbol of the head of the revered House of Hoslow.

Juno Hoslow had a younger brother who was all talk and no trousers.

His inability to commit to action was such that Juno inherited the Hoslow legacy without resistance, granting him the freedom to shower his little brother with adoration.

o.en: Reward for defeating Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood in Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance. Can be missed.

armaduras.d:
Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails.

Diallos Hoslow had an older brother who was a stern, self-possessed man of few words. His achievements made him seem out of reach.

And so the younger aspired to be like the older. Yearning for the day that he would tell the tale of House Hoslow, in blood. Knowing full well that it would break his brother's heart.

o.en: Dropped by Potentate Diallos in Liurnia of the Lakes - Jarburg, Divine Tower of Liurnia Entrance. Can be missed.

Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

The two known as D are inseparable twins.
They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

o.en: Found in Deeproot Depths (Siofra River). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River). Pode ser perdido.

Black iron helm worn by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

o.en: Inside a chest in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Crumbling Farum Azula, perto da graça Dragon Temple Rooftop.

Battered iron helm from a foreign land.
Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 4.000 runas depois de derrotar Elemer of the Briar.

armaduras.d:
Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers.
Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

o.en: Reward for defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke in Mountaintops of the Giants - Southwest Freezing Lake, Lord Contender's Evergaol, Spiritcaller Cave Entrance.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Roundtable Knight Vyke em Mountaintops of the Giants - Southwest Freezing Lake, Lord Contender's Evergaol, Spiritcaller Cave Entrance.

armaduras.d:
Helm graced with gold human bones.
Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord―the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

o.en: Found in Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), near the Table of Lost Grace grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), perto da graça Table of Lost Grace. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Helm set with countless eyes and ears.
Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

o.en: Reward for defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Leyndell, Royal Capital).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing em Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Leyndell, Royal Capital).

armaduras.d:
Silver helm of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Royal Knight Loretta.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 4.000 runas depois de derrotar Royal Knight Loretta.

armaduras.d:
Beast's helm made of black iron and decorated with gold.
Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake.
Indeed, that is what made them champions.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 10,000 runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 10.000 runas depois de derrotar Maliketh, the Black Blade.

armaduras.d:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body.
This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Perhaps the deep-red scarf was used to block the winds, for on the outskirts, the winds bite with a stinging fierceness.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que vestem este conjunto.

Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body.
This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

Pitch-black helm with flowing black hair.
Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

o.en: Reward for defeating Night's Cavalry (Glaive) in Consecrated Snowfield - Northwest Foggy Area, East of Yelough Anix Ruins (Mountaintops of the Giants). Only at night.

An old helm that has seen many battles.
Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Commander Niall.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 4.000 runas depois de derrotar Commander Niall.

armaduras.d:
Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan.
The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

o.en: Reward for defeating Old Knight Istvan in Stormhill - North of Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave). Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Old Knight Istvan em Stormhill - North of Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave). Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts.
Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

The beasts, their eyes and ears covered, represent an oath: "See nothing, hear nothing, doubt nothing, and carry on, along the path set in stone."

o.en: Reward for defeating Recusant Bernahl in Crumbling Farum Azula. Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Recusant Bernahl em Crumbling Farum Azula. Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Very few are permitted to wear a golden wood crest of such size as seen on this helm.

o.en: Reward for defeating Merciless Chariot in Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Merciless Chariot em Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).

armaduras.d:
A malformed golden helm.
Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

o.en: Reward for defeating Draconic Tree Sentinel in Crumbling Farum Azula.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Draconic Tree Sentinel em Crumbling Farum Azula.

armaduras.d:
Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

o.en: Reward for defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis in Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Crucible Knight Ordovis em Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).

Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River), perto da graça The Nameless Eternal City.

armaduras.d:
Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair.
Worn by General Radahn.

Radahn inherited the furious, flaming red hair of his father Radagon, and is fond of its heroic implications.

"I was born a champion's cub. Now I am the Lord of the Battlefield's lion."

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 8,000 runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 8.000 runas depois de derrotar Starscourge Radahn.

Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim.
Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Lower Capital Church grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Lower Capital Church.

Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

o.en: Reward for defeating Great Horned Tragoth in Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes). Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Great Horned Tragoth em Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes). Pode ser perdido.

armaduras.d:
Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, its form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence?
What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all?

o.en: Found in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Pode ser perdido.

Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

It is said the cauldron perched atop the head was originally furnished with embers, and would surge into flames when the wearer's faith reached its zenith. The fire of this cauldron has since died out, however.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that wear this set.

An oval helm large enough to cover any head.
Very heavy and very hard.

Reduces damage from headshots and impacts.

The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking.
Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

o.en: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes - Behind Caria Manor, Royal Grave Evergaol, Part of Ravine, near the Manor Upper Level grace.

Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.

Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep navy garb after making their vows of virtue and austerity.

But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

These scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars.
This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside.
Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape.

o.en: Dropped by Battlemage in Altus Plateau - West Windmill Pasture, near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace.
